entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hm, this place is very spacious[n]when you take a real look around.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Everyone seems to be enjoying[n]themselves too. I see why they[n]call this the kingdom of dreams.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh, do you remember those[n]weird hats we saw some[n]people wearing earlier?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: They'd look out of place anywhere[n]else, but they fit in here.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hm...
I'll get one for you.
Do you want to try one on?
It'd look great on you.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Huh? But... are you sure?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: No, it's okay! I'd feel bad[n]about making you buy it...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: N-Not necessarily...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Although... we came all the way[n]here, right? When in Rome...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Really!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I-I mean, um... never mind.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: To be honest though... I've wanted[n]one since I first saw them.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I suppose it's kind of like our[n]disguises in the Metaverse, right?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...Should we go check out[n]one of the shops?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: They didn't have any[n]either of us wanted...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But the employee there did[n]say they have different hats[n]at different stores...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Why don't we check the other[n]ones as we make our way around[n]the park for the rides?
Okay.
That would be efficient.
This is going to be fun![clr 27]

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Great. We've come all this[n]way, so we should enjoy it[n]while we can.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yeah... I don't want to waste[n]any time I spend with you.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I agree. Just being here[n]has raised my spirits.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You know... I wondered if I should[n]be out having fun like this when I[n]have exams to study for...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But I realized that reading[n]textbooks won't help me see[n]the world outside.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm sorry that's such a logical[n]approach... I'm not so good at[n]being a bubbly girlfriend...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Please stay with me[n]forever, [fName].

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hey, um... can we hold hands[n]on our way to the station?
